name: KDE Discover
description: No self-update; delegates to PackageKit/backends, preserving distro signing.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Discover configures Flatpak remotes with GPG verification only when a remote key is supplied; package installation is delegated to backend trust settings.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
